world.title: Nvidia Does Not Intend to Bring Back Huang as CEO, Chair Says
world.summary: Harvey Jones, chair of Nvidia's board, says former CEO Jensen Huang voluntarily resigned and the board does not intend to rehire him. He spoke on the earnings call after Nvidia said sales will increase 75% in fiscal 2028. Jones also talked about the effort to replace Huang. Bloomberg's Ed Ludlow reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

world.title: Signal blocks screenshots on iOS 27 and Android to stop AI agents from reading private chats
world.summary: Signal is blocking screenshots to stop AI agents like Apple's Siri AI, Google's Gemini Intelligence, and Meta's Muse from reading private chats. The app calls it an "existential threat" to privacy, but admits its protections remain incomplete, including on macOS. Apple, Google, and Microsoft should follow suit.
